title: Gifts of the Spirit and the Body of Christ
description: Paul teaches the church in Corinth about the various spiritual gifts given by the Holy Spirit and explains how believers together form the body of Christ with different, yet mutually dependent functions.

versions.title: Gifts of the Spirit in the Church
versions.description: Paul teaches the church in Corinth about the various spiritual gifts and how believers make up the body of Christ with different functions.
